media.notes: Albumen print of a breaking wave and heavy sky. Strongest image in the set. Grayscale, autocontrast.

media.credit: Gustave Le Gray, "Brig on the Water", 1856. Art Institute of Chicago.
media.licence: CC0 1.0 (Art Institute of Chicago Open Access; work is public domain)
media.notes: Silver light on dark sea, a liquid-metal / mercury feel. Mount edge cropped.

media.credit: Gustave Le Gray, "Seascape, Normandy", 1856/57. Art Institute of Chicago.
media.licence: CC0 1.0 (Art Institute of Chicago Open Access; work is public domain)
media.notes: Soft silver sea with sun glints. Low contrast, good as a quiet background. Mount edge cropped.

media.licence: CC0 1.0 (Art Institute of Chicago Open Access; work is public domain)

media.credit: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎, "Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from th", 1830/33. Art Institute of Chicago.
media.licence: CC0 1.0 (Art Institute of Chicago Open Access; work is public domain)
media.notes: Hokusai, the Great Wave. Reads well in grayscale. Iconic, so maybe overused; use sparingly.
